title: Echo in the Theater
description: A woman in a shiny silver dress sits in a red velvet theater seat, exhaling a visible beam of light from her mouth that projects upward. On the large cinema screen above her, the same woman appears in an identical pose, with a ghostly male figure standing beside her also emitting a light beam.
prompt: A woman with dark curly hair wearing a metallic silver satin dress sits alone in an ornate old theater with red velvet seats. She exhales a bright beam of light from her mouth that projects toward the large screen in front of her. The screen displays the exact same scene of her sitting and projecting light, with a translucent man in a suit standing beside her also emitting a light beam from his mouth. Dramatic cinematic lighting, painterly style with visible brushstrokes and gold leaf accents.
